title: kithctl watch: pinned cert loaded synchronously from disk — file not re-read on kithd cert rotation
description: cmd_watch reads the kithd TLS cert once at startup (watch.rs line 634) and pins it for the lifetime of the process. If kithd rotates its self-signed cert (e.g. on restart after cert expiry), watch will fail TLS handshakes with 'server certificate does not match pinned certificate' and loop-reconnect forever, logging the error every 2 seconds. There is no cert-refresh path, no diagnostic distinguishing cert mismatch from other TLS failures, and no 'stop reconnecting on cert mismatch' logic. Operators will see an infinite error loop that looks like a network problem.
